apiEntry.intro: Cashier devices (WPF / handheld / iPad) reach the POS API through three routes: EdgeOne, AWS Sydney and Direct to Singapore. All three lead to the same backend. Pick the preferred route for each store here; the other two act as fallbacks automatically: if the preferred route is unreachable the device switches to the next one at once, and switches back after recovery. Changes take effect within about 1 minute (slower at night), with no restart and no impact on payments in progress.

modeDescriptions.edge: Tencent multi-node acceleration; billed per request.
modeDescriptions.aws: Self-hosted Sydney edge with warm connections and fast first requests; network independent of Tencent; single server.
modeDescriptions.direct: Straight to the Singapore origin with no middle layer; unstable on a few ISPs.
